insights.summary: PreSense routing and context help agents close more calls from digital shoppers.
insights.quote: Agents really like seeing the pages a caller browsed before they pick up. It gives them something to work with right away, and it's helping them close more of those calls that started as digital shoppers.

insights.summary: Signal AI spam detection flags legitimate after-hours or weekend callers as spam, removing real customers from reporting.
insights.quote: Signal AI is flagging legitimate after-hours or weekend callers as spam. So real customers are getting pulled out of our reporting entirely.
